Pilot’s full SotW push can regenerate/send LDS with a new `version_info` even when the serialized listener hash is unchanged; Envoy’s LDS path still calls `addOrUpdateListener`, builds a replacement, warms it, then drains the old listener.

- [envoy--v1.29.4:source/common/listener_manager/listener_manager_impl.cc?L449-L505](/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.29.4/-/blob/source/common/listener_manager/listener_manager_impl.cc?L449-L505) - Public `addOrUpdateListener`; resolves listener name and delegates to the internal update path.
